reason: The cited evidence directly supports the superior CO oxidation activity of Pd1@HEFO over Pd@CeO2 and links it to support reducibility, but it does not provide specific evidence for the formation of robust PGM–O–M bonds enhanced by multicomponent mixing, nor for the long-term sintering resistance of these single atoms under automotive conditions.
premises: Atomically dispersed PGMs on high-entropy fluorite oxide form robust PGM–O–M bonds that stabilize single atoms against sintering.
The high-entropy support enhances these bonds via multicomponent mixing.
Pd1@HEFO shows dramatically lower CO oxidation light-off temperatures than Pd@CeO2.
The improved activity is linked to enhanced reducibility of surface lattice oxygen in the high-entropy support.
Single-atom catalysts on conventional supports require careful synthesis control and are prone to sintering.
